description: This file contains a JUnit-based instrumentation test class for the Android application SpinnerActivity. It tests UI interactions, initial conditions, and state management of the Spinner widget within the SpinnerActivity, including tests for preserving state across activity lifecycle events.

classes.name: SpinnerActivityTest
classes.description: A test suite for the SpinnerActivity, verifying UI behavior, initial conditions, and lifecycle state preservation.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, loads the activity and references key UI components and data.

methods.name: testPreconditions
methods.description: Verifies initial object states and correct setup of the Spinner and data adapter.

methods.name: testSpinnerUI
methods.description: Simulates user interaction with the Spinner UI, verifying selection updates display correctly.

methods.name: testStateDestroy
methods.description: Checks if the Spinner state is preserved across activity restart after finish().

methods.name: testStatePause
methods.description: Verifies Spinner state preservation through activity lifecycle events like pause and resume.
